locked_defaults.markets_note: [ASSUMPTION] US-first; not derived from a stage-01 lock.

key_facts.wedge: [ASSUMPTION] D2C made-on-demand brand: type a piece of internet gossip/drama ('tea') -> AI generates original t-shirt designs -> human approval -> Printify fulfillment, on premium Bella+Canvas blanks.
key_facts.problem: Topical humor goes stale fast; people want to wear a cultural moment that is original, fast, and quality-made.
key_facts.top_competitor_threat: Jeff The Brotherhood (Trending Gifts) - the only live reactive POD brand already doing daily trend-driven drops, though it sells generic-trendy slogans rather than sharp gossip.
top_pain_patterns: Shipping delays and 'label created' limbo; no human customer service
Generic, samey AI output with broken text rendering; nothing feels personal
key_facts.biggest_market_gap: No brand owns 'internet gossip/tea -> wearable' as a sharp, self-serve, curated, human-checked experience for Gen-Z; reactive brands do generic slogans, marketplaces are saturated and low-trust, AI tools are generic.
key_facts.pricing_landscape_summary: Topical graphic tees list ~$22-30 (marketplaces discount to $15-18); direct reactive brand lists $29.99/sale $21.99. Our planned $29.99 sits at the top of the band, defensible only on brand + quality + timeliness.
key_facts.recommended_positioning: [inference] 'The fastest way to wear the drama - type the tea, get an original only you have, human-checked and premium-printed.' Compete on taste, timeliness, personalization, and trust, not on 'we have AI.'
